pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Thullanandā bhikkhunī samaggena saṃghena ukkhittaṃ Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ anuvattati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā Thullanandā samaggena . . . anuvattissatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī samaggena . . . anuvattatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.8: hi nāma bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī samaggena . . . anuvattissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.9: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.10: evan ca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.11.1: yā pana bhikkhunī samaggena saṃghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anādaraṃ apaṭikāraṃ akatasahāyaṃ tam anuvatteyya, sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi evam assa vacanīyā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.12: eso kho ayye bhikkhu samaggena saṃghena ukkhitto dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anādaro apaṭikāro akatasahāyo, māyye etaṃ bhikkhuṃ anuvattīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.13: evañ ca sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi vuccamānā tath' eva paggaṇheyya, sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.14: yāvatatiyaṃ ce samanubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.15: no ce paṭinissajjeyya, ayam pi pārājikā hoti asaṃvāsā ukkhittānuvattikā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.8: āpattiyā adassanena vā appaṭikammena vā appaṭinissaggena vā ukkhitto.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.14: saṃghaṃ vā gaṇaṃ vā puggalaṃ vā kammaṃ vā nādiyati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.19: so tehi saddhiṃ n' atthi, tena vuccati akatasahāyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.21: yaṃdiṭṭhiko so hoti yaṃkhantiko yaṃruciko sāpi taṃdiṭṭhikā hoti taṃkhantikā taṃrucikā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.25: aññāhi bhikkhunīhi yā passanti yā suṇanti tāhi vattabbā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.26: eso kho ayye bhikkhu samaggena saṃghena ukkhitto dhammena . . .
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.33: sā bhikkhunī saṃghamajjhaṃ pi ākaḍḍhitvā vattabbā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.34: eso kho ayye bhikkhu samaggena saṃghena ukkhitto dhammena . . .
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.44: ayaṃ itthannāmā bhikkhunī samaggena saṃghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anādaraṃ apaṭikāraṃ akatasahāyaṃ tam anuvattati. sā taṃ vatthuṃ na paṭinissajjati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.45: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ samanubhāseyya tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.50: saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ samanubhāsati tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.51: yassā ayyāya khamati itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā samanubhāsanā tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya sā tuṇh' assa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.55: samanubhaṭṭhā saṃghena itthannāmā bhikkhunī tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.63: seyyathāpi nāma puthusilā dvedhā bhinnā appaṭisandhikā hoti, evam eva bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjantī assamaṇī hoti asakyadhītā. tena vuccati pārājikā hotīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.2.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññā na paṭinissajjati, āpatti pārājikassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.2.2: dhammakamme vematikā na paṭinissajjati, āpatti pārājikassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.2.3: dhammakamme adhammakammasaññā na paṭinissajjati, āpatti pārājikassa.
